family_structure.rule: Every hypothesis of the family, the primary included, is tested with the Holm correction at the same alpha, so no hypothesis waits for another and the order of the family does not change a verdict. Equivalence inside a margin is shown by two one-sided tests at alpha, and their p values are adjusted by the Holm correction over the hypotheses that have a margin. These are two families, each held at alpha, so a plan that mixes both kinds of claim can reach twice alpha for any false claim across them. The primary hypothesis is the one reported first. The design diagnosis measures the power of every hypothesis at alpha divided by the number of hypotheses, the level of the worst Holm step.

if_then.measure: a program does not converge or its data separate
if_then.rule: The fallback family that the program declares runs instead of its family.

if_then.measure: rows of a level of the exposure or of a categorical covariate
if_then.rule: Every level of the exposure or of a categorical covariate with fewer rows than the threshold is merged with the other such levels into one level. When one level is that small, it is merged with the smallest other level. A merge that would leave fewer than two levels, or that would merge the reference level or the event level of the program, is not applied and is recorded as a deviation.

if_then.measure: a curved relation of the exposure and the outcome
if_then.reason: No code measures a curved relation without reading the outcome with the exposure, and the registry has no spline family, so the branch is deferred.
if_then.rule: The main analysis stays as it is; a spline analysis is registered as a robustness analysis.

if_then.measure: the share by which the analysed rows differ from the planned rows
if_then.rule: The power of the design is computed again at the analysed rows. When it is below the power floor and the run is still blind, the stage goes back to the experiment design.

if_then.measure: the share of rows with a missing value in the variables of a program
if_then.reason: The multiple imputation branch is deferred; the run records the signal.
if_then.rule: A multiple imputation analysis of the missing data is registered.

if_then.measure: the main program of a hypothesis is a linear regression with at least one covariate (a fact of the plan; no row is read)
if_then.rule: The main analysis stays as it is; a Freedman-Lane permutation test of the exposure coefficient (residuals of the model without the exposure permuted, the t of the exposure compared) is computed as a robustness analysis. It changes no verdict.

if_then.measure: a fit separates on the levels of a categorical covariate
if_then.rule: When a fit separates, every level of a categorical covariate with fewer rows than the threshold is merged with the other such levels into one level, and the program's family is fitted again. When one level is that small, it is merged with the smallest other level. The first level is the reference of the model and is not merged. A merge that would leave fewer than two levels is not applied. When the fit still does not compute, the declared fallback family runs.
